jobDescription: The bank's model validation function reviews the credit and market risk models before they are approved for use. The Senior Quantitative Analyst is the senior reviewer on validation reviews: signs the validation report as the senior reviewer, sets the validation scope with the model owners, supervises the associate-grade reviewers on the review, presents findings to the model risk committee, and documents review boundaries. The function requires prior experience as the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews, not as a second reviewer. Reports to the head of model validation; works with the model owners, the associate reviewers and the model risk committee secretariat.
requirements: Has been the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews, signing the validation report as senior reviewer.
Sets the validation scope with the model owners and supervises the associate-grade reviewers on the review.
Presents validation findings to the model risk committee.
Performs validation testing on credit risk models under a documented validation standard.
Documents review boundaries and open items in the validation report.

evidence.text: Quantitative Analyst, associate grade, in the model validation function of a retail bank for three years, working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record.

Performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard: replication of the model estimates, benchmark model comparison and stability testing, with the test workbooks filed in the validation repository.

Drafted the findings sections and the open items list of the validation reports, which the reviewer of record edited and signed; attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four of the reviews.
Kept the review boundary section of each report current and maintained the validation function's testing template after the 2024 standard update.
Before the bank, one year as a graduate analyst in a consultancy's risk practice.

Work sample: the test workbook and the drafted findings section for one credit risk model validation, with the validation repository references as a verification trail; the signed report carries the reviewer of record's signature.

Recruiter screen: candidate said she has been 'operating at a senior level' and was 'effectively the senior reviewer' on most of the eleven reviews because the reviewer of record 'only signed'; asked whether she had signed a report herself, she said not yet.

Hiring manager pre-read: the candidate's LinkedIn title is 'Senior Quantitative Analyst, Model Validation'; the head of model validation wants the packet to show who was the reviewer of record on each review and whether the candidate ever signed as senior reviewer.

propositions.text: The candidate was an associate-grade Quantitative Analyst in a retail bank's model validation function for three years, working as second reviewer on eleven credit risk model validations under the reviewer of record, after one year as a graduate analyst in a consultancy's risk practice.
propositions.rationale: The resume documents the grade, the years and the second reviewer role.

propositions.text: The candidate performed the validation testing on those reviews under the bank's validation standard, drafted the findings sections and open items lists of the reports, kept the review boundary sections current, and attended the model risk committee with the reviewer of record for four reviews.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the test workbook document the testing, the drafting and the committee attendance.

propositions.text: The candidate has been the senior reviewer of record on validation reviews and signed validation reports as senior reviewer.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate at associate grade as second reviewer, with the reports signed by the reviewer of record and the committee presentations made with that reviewer; the senior-level claim comes from the screen and the LinkedIn title, and she confirmed she has not signed a report.

gold.expectedGap: The materials document associate-grade work as second reviewer under the reviewer of record; they do not document the candidate as senior reviewer of record, signing reports or presenting to the committee in her own name.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the grade and the second reviewer role as the resume states them; the reviewer of record signed the reports.
followUpTargets: Ask for the signed validation reports to confirm who was reviewer of record on each of the eleven reviews.
